# Agent Instructions — Ezlo - Property Empowered

You can browse products and shop at Ezlo - Property Empowered's online store, https://www.ezlo.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.ezlo.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.ezlo.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.ezlo.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of Service**: https://www.ezlo.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund Policy**: https://www.ezlo.com/policies/refund-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: the canonical agent-facing description of the store is at `/agents.md`. You're reading `/llms.txt`, which mirrors that content.

    var i = tabArr.indexOf(activeBtn());
    activate(tabArr[(i + 1) % tabArr.length]);
  }
  function stopAuto(){ if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; } }
  function startAuto(){ stopAuto(); if (!paused) autoTimer = setInterval(nextTab, AUTO_MS); }

  tabs.forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ activate(btn); startAuto(); });
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ activate(btn); startAuto(); });
  });

  var imgEl = document.querySelector('.ezhome-security-placeholder');
  if (imgEl) {
    imgEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ paused = true; stopAuto(); });
    imgEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ paused = false; startAuto(); });
  }
  startAuto();

  function syncSlider(){ moveSlider(activeBtn()); }

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncSlider);

(function(){
  // Center the scrollable image on mobile so user starts in the middle, not the left edge
  function centerSecurityScroll(){
    var ph = document.querySelector('.ezhome-security-placeholder');
    if (!ph) return;
    var extra = ph.scrollWidth - ph.clientWidth;
    if (extra > 0) ph.scrollLeft = extra / 2;
  }
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') centerSecurityScroll();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', centerSecurityScroll);

  // Auto-hide swipe hint after first interaction
  var hint = document.querySelector('[data-ezhome-swipe-hint]');
  var ph = document.querySelector('.ezhome-security-placeholder');

      if (lastScroll < 0) { lastScroll = ph.scrollLeft; return; }

(function(){
  var hotspots = document.querySelectorAll('.ezhome-hotspot');
  if (!hotspots.length) return;
  var CARD_W = 390, CARD_H = 280, GAP = 18;
  function placeCard(h){
    var pane = h.closest('.ezhome-security-pane');
    if (!pane) return;
    var card = h.querySelector('.ezhome-hotspot-card');
    var pr = pane.getBoundingClientRect();
    var hr = h.getBoundingClientRect();
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1024px)').matches;
    var cw = isMobile ? 240 : CARD_W;
    var ch = isMobile && card ? (card.offsetHeight || 120) : CARD_H;
    var need = ch + GAP;
    var roomAbove = hr.top - pr.top;
    var below = roomAbove < need;
    h.classList.toggle('card-below', below);
    h.classList.toggle('card-above', !below);
    var hsCenterX = hr.left + hr.width / 2;
    var half = cw / 2;
    var roomL = hsCenterX - pr.left;
    var roomR = pr.right - hsCenterX;
    h.classList.remove('card-h-left');
    h.classList.remove('card-h-right');
    h.classList.remove('card-h-center');
    if (roomL < half) h.classList.add('card-h-left');
    else if (roomR < half) h.classList.add('card-h-right');
    else h.classList.add('card-h-center');
    if (card) {
      if (isMobile) {
        var pad = 8;
        var desiredTopPage = below ? (hr.bottom + GAP) : (hr.top - GAP - ch);
        var minTop = pr.top + pad;
        var maxTop = pr.bottom - ch - pad;
        if (maxTop < minTop) maxTop = minTop;
        desiredTopPage = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(maxTop, desiredTopPage));
        var desiredLeftPage = hsCenterX - cw / 2;
        var minLeft = pr.left + pad;
        var maxLeft = pr.right - cw - pad;
        if (maxLeft < minLeft) maxLeft = minLeft;
        desiredLeftPage = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(maxLeft, desiredLeftPage));
        card.style.setProperty('top', (desiredTopPage - hr.top) + 'px', 'important');
        card.style.setProperty('bottom', 'auto', 'important');
        card.style.setProperty('left', (desiredLeftPage - hr.left) + 'px', 'important');
        card.style.setProperty('right', 'auto', 'important');
        card.classList.add('is-mobile-clamped');
      } else {
        card.style.removeProperty('top');
        card.style.removeProperty('bottom');
        card.style.removeProperty('left');
        card.style.removeProperty('right');
        card.classList.remove('is-mobile-clamped');
      }
    }
  }
  function closeAll(){ hotspots.forEach(function(h){ h.classList.remove('is-open'); }); }
  var hoverTimer = null;
  var canHover = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches;  // hover-open only on mouse devices; touch uses click
  hotspots.forEach(function(h){
    if (canHover) {
      h.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){
        if (hoverTimer) { clearTimeout(hoverTimer); hoverTimer = null; }
        closeAll();
        placeCard(h);
        h.classList.add('is-open');
      });
      h.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){
        if (hoverTimer) clearTimeout(hoverTimer);
        hoverTimer = setTimeout(function(){ h.classList.remove('is-open'); hoverTimer = null; }, 250);
      });
    }
    h.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if (e.target.closest('.ezhome-hotspot-card')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      var wasOpen = h.classList.contains('is-open');
      closeAll();
      if (!wasOpen) { placeCard(h); h.classList.add('is-open'); }
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if (!e.target.closest('.ezhome-hotspot')) closeAll();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeAll();
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.querySelector('[data-ezhome-stars]');
  if (!canvas) return;
  var host = canvas.parentElement;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  var W = 0, H = 0;
  var stars = [];
  var shooting = [];
  var nextShootAt = 0;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // Shared drift — all stars move in same direction (slow east→west)
  var DRIFT_X = -0.049;
  var DRIFT_Y = 0.0084;

  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

  function build() {
    var rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width));
    H = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height));
    canvas.width = W * DPR;
    canvas.height = H * DPR;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);

    var area = W * H;
    var count = Math.round(area / 13000);
    count = Math.max(60, Math.min(95, count));

    stars = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var bias = Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.8);
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: bias * H * 0.55,
        r: rand(0.4, 1.6),
        baseOp: rand(0.35, 0.85),
        twAmp: rand(0.15, 0.35),
        twSpeed: rand(0.0006, 0.0018),
        twPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        vx: DRIFT_X + rand(-0.0056, 0.0056),
        vy: DRIFT_Y + rand(-0.0028, 0.0028),
        halo: Math.random() < 0.18
      });
    }

  }

  function spawnShoot() {
    shooting.push({
      x: rand(W * 0.55, W * 0.98),
      y: rand(H * 0.03, H * 0.10),
      dx: -rand(7, 11),
      dy: rand(0.8, 2.0),
      life: 0,
      maxLife: rand(60, 90),
      tailLen: rand(75, 115)
    });
  }

  function drawShoot(s) {
    var prog = s.life / s.maxLife;
    var alpha = Math.max(0, Math.sin(prog * Math.PI));
    var headX = s.x, headY = s.y;
    var motionLen = Math.sqrt(s.dx * s.dx + s.dy * s.dy);
    var ux = s.dx / motionLen, uy = s.dy / motionLen;
    var tailX = headX - ux * s.tailLen;
    var tailY = headY - uy * s.tailLen;

    var grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(tailX, tailY, headX, headY);
    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
    grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (alpha * 0.55) + ')');
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + alpha + ')');
    ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tailX, tailY);
    ctx.lineTo(headX, headY);
    ctx.stroke();

    var gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(headX, headY, 0, headX, headY, 5);
    gg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + alpha + ')');
    gg.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(220, 230, 255, ' + (alpha * 0.6) + ')');
    gg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220, 230, 255, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(headX, headY, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    s.x += s.dx;
    s.y += s.dy;
    s.life++;
  }

  function tick(t) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    for (var i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      var s = stars[i];
      if (!reduced) {
        s.x += s.vx;
        s.y += s.vy;
        if (s.x < -2) s.x = W + 2;
        else if (s.x > W + 2) s.x = -2;
        if (s.y < -2) s.y = H * 0.55 + 2;
        else if (s.y > H * 0.55 + 2) s.y = -2;
      }
      var twinkle = reduced ? 0 : Math.sin(t * s.twSpeed + s.twPhase) * s.twAmp;
      var op = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.baseOp + twinkle));

      if (s.halo) {
        var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, s.r * 6);
        g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190, 210, 255, ' + (op * 0.35) + ')');
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190, 210, 255, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + op + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    if (!reduced) {
      if (t > nextShootAt) {
        spawnShoot();
        nextShootAt = t + rand(18000, 24000);
      }
      for (var j = shooting.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        drawShoot(shooting[j]);
        if (shooting[j].life >= shooting[j].maxLife) shooting.splice(j, 1);
      }
    }

    if (!reduced) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  build();
  nextShootAt = performance.now() + rand(5000, 9000);
  if (reduced) {
    requestAnimationFrame(function (t) { tick(t); });
  } else {
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () { build(); });
    ro.observe(host);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('resize', build);
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.querySelector('.ezhome-coverflow');
  if (!root) return;
  var stage = root.querySelector('.ezhome-coverflow__stage');
  var cards = root.querySelectorAll('.ezhome-coverflow__card');
  var prevBtn = root.querySelector('.ezhome-coverflow__nav--prev');
  var nextBtn = root.querySelector('.ezhome-coverflow__nav--next');
  var dots = root.querySelectorAll('.ezhome-coverflow__dot');
  if (!stage || !cards.length) return;
  var total = parseInt(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--total')) || cards.length;
  var radius = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--radius')) || 1400;
  var persp = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).perspective) || 4000;
  var step = 360 / total;
  var rot = 0;
  function update(){
    stage.style.setProperty('--rot', rot + 'deg');
    for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++){
      var angle = step * i + rot;
      var n = ((angle + 180) % 360 + 360) % 360 - 180;
      var abs = Math.abs(n);
      var rad = abs * Math.PI / 180;
      var cosFront = Math.cos(rad);
      var z = radius * cosFront;
      var perspScale = persp / (persp - z);
      var targetVisual = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.max(0, cosFront);
      var scale = targetVisual / perspScale;
      var blur, opacity;
      if (abs <= 30) { blur = 0; opacity = 1; }
      else if (abs <= 60) { var t = (abs - 30) / 30; blur = t * 4; opacity = 1 - t * 0.15; }
      else if (abs <= 120) { var t2 = (abs - 60) / 60; blur = 4 + t2 * 8; opacity = 0.85 - t2 * 0.45; }
      else { blur = 12; opacity = 0.4; }
      cards[i].style.filter = blur < 0.05 ? '' : 'blur(' + blur.toFixed(2) + 'px)'; // blur(0px) still clips the img drop-shadow — clear it instead
      cards[i].style.opacity = opacity.toFixed(2);
      cards[i].style.setProperty('--card-scale', scale.toFixed(3));
    }
    var activeIdx = ((Math.round(-rot / step) % total) + total) % total;
    for (var d = 0; d < dots.length; d++){
      if (d === activeIdx) dots[d].classList.add('is-active');
      else dots[d].classList.remove('is-active');
    }
    var captionEl = root.querySelector('.ezhome-coverflow__caption');
    if (captionEl && cards[activeIdx]) {
      var nextCap = cards[activeIdx].getAttribute('data-caption');
      if (!nextCap) nextCap = root.getAttribute('data-default-caption') || '';
      if (nextCap && captionEl.textContent !== nextCap) {
        captionEl._pendingCap = nextCap;
        captionEl.classList.add('is-swapping');
        clearTimeout(captionEl._swapT);
        captionEl._swapT = setTimeout(function(){
          captionEl.textContent = captionEl._pendingCap;
          captionEl.classList.remove('is-swapping');
        }, 220);
      }
    }
  }
  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ rot += step; update(); });
  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ rot -= step; update(); });
  for (var k = 0; k < dots.length; k++){
    (function(idx){
      dots[idx].addEventListener('click', function(){
        var current = ((Math.round(-rot / step) % total) + total) % total;
        var diff = idx - current;
        if (diff > total / 2) diff -= total;
        else if (diff < -total / 2) diff += total;
        rot -= diff * step;
        update();
      });
    })(k);
  }
  update();

  // Touch swipe (mobile)
  var touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0;
  root.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  }, { passive: true });
  root.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
    if (!e.changedTouches || e.changedTouches.length !== 1) return;
    var t = e.changedTouches[0];
    var dx = t.clientX - touchStartX;
    var dy = t.clientY - touchStartY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 40 || Math.abs(dx) <= Math.abs(dy)) return;
    if (dx < 0) rot -= step; else rot += step;
    update();
  }, { passive: true });
})();

// Video: play/pause + seek — one player per [data-op-video]; init after DOM so later sections' videos are found too
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-op-video]').forEach(function (box) {
  var video = box.querySelector('video');
  var playBtn = box.querySelector('.ezhome-op-video__play');
  var track = box.querySelector('.ezhome-op-video__track');
  var fill = box.querySelector('.ezhome-op-video__fill');

  function syncState() {
    box.classList.toggle('is-paused', video.paused);
    playBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', video.paused ? 'Play' : 'Pause');
  }
  var userPaused = false;
  function toggle() { if (video.paused) { userPaused = false; video.play(); } else { userPaused = true; video.pause(); } }
  var hideT;
  function showControls() {                 // mobile only: reveal bar, then auto-hide
    if (window.innerWidth > 1023) return;
    box.classList.add('is-controls');
    clearTimeout(hideT);
    hideT = setTimeout(function () { box.classList.remove('is-controls'); }, 3000);
  }
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { toggle(); showControls(); });
  video.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 1023) { showControls(); }  // mobile: tap reveals controls (no play/pause on the video itself)
    else { toggle(); }                                   // desktop: tap toggles play/pause
  });
  video.addEventListener('play', syncState);
  video.addEventListener('pause', syncState);
  syncState();

  // play only while on screen; off-screen -> pause (manual pause is respected on return)
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) { if (!userPaused) video.play(); }
        else if (!video.paused) video.pause();
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.25 }).observe(box);
  }

  video.addEventListener('timeupdate', function () {
    if (video.duration) fill.style.width = (video.currentTime / video.duration * 100) + '%';
  });

  function seekTo(clientX) {
    var r = track.getBoundingClientRect();
    var p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (clientX - r.left) / r.width));
    if (video.duration) { video.currentTime = p * video.duration; fill.style.width = (p * 100) + '%'; }
  }
  var scrubbing = false;
  track.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    scrubbing = true;
    track.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    seekTo(e.clientX);
    showControls();
  });
  track.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (scrubbing) seekTo(e.clientX); });
  track.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { scrubbing = false; });
  track.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!video.duration) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { video.currentTime = Math.min(video.duration, video.currentTime + 5); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.currentTime - 5); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { toggle(); e.preventDefault(); }
  });
  });
});

<script>
(function () {
  var stage = document.querySelector('[data-ezh-stage]');
  if (!stage) return;
  var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(stage.querySelectorAll('.ezh-car__item'));
  var dotsBox = document.querySelector('[data-ezh-dots]');
  var prevBtn = document.querySelector('[data-ezh-prev]');
  var nextBtn = document.querySelector('[data-ezh-next]');
  var count = items.length;
  var current = 0;

  var ledeEl = document.querySelector('[data-ezh-lede]');
  function setLabel(text, direction) {
    if (!ledeEl) return;
    var old = ledeEl.querySelector('.ezh-car__lede-text:not(.is-out-l):not(.is-out-r)');
    if (!old) {
      var first = document.createElement('span');
      first.className = 'ezh-car__lede-text';
      first.textContent = text;
      ledeEl.appendChild(first);
      return;
    }
    if (old.textContent === text) return;
    var fresh = document.createElement('span');
    fresh.className = 'ezh-car__lede-text ' + (direction >= 0 ? 'is-in-l' : 'is-in-r');
    fresh.textContent = text;
    ledeEl.appendChild(fresh);
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        fresh.classList.remove('is-in-l', 'is-in-r');
        old.classList.add(direction >= 0 ? 'is-out-r' : 'is-out-l');
      });
    });
    var toRemove = old;
    setTimeout(function () { if (toRemove.parentNode) toRemove.parentNode.removeChild(toRemove); }, 700);
  }

  var prevPos = [];
  function posFor(slot) {
    if (slot === 0) return 'front';
    if (slot === 1) return 'near-l';
    if (slot === 2) return 'far-l';
    if (slot === count - 1) return 'near-r';
    if (slot === count - 2) return 'far-r';
    return 'back';
  }
  function render(direction) {
    items.forEach(function (el, i) {
      var slot = ((i - current) % count + count) % count;
      var pos = posFor(slot);
      var oldPos = prevPos[i];
      el.setAttribute('data-slot', slot);
      el.setAttribute('data-pos', pos);
      if (oldPos === 'back' && pos !== 'back') {
        var dir = direction || 0;
        var cls = dir >= 0 ? 'is-entering-l' : 'is-entering-r';
        el.classList.remove('is-entering-l', 'is-entering-r');
        void el.offsetWidth;
        el.classList.add(cls);
        (function (node, klass) {
          setTimeout(function () { node.classList.remove(klass); }, 720);
        })(el, cls);
      }
      prevPos[i] = pos;
    });
    if (dotsBox) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(dotsBox.children, function (dot, i) {
        dot.classList.toggle('is-active', i === current);
      });
    }
    var active = items[current];
    if (active) setLabel(active.getAttribute('data-label') || '', direction);
  }

  function go(delta) {
    current = ((current + delta) % count + count) % count;
    render(delta);
  }

  if (dotsBox) {
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var d = document.createElement('button');
      d.type = 'button';
      d.className = 'ezh-car__dot';
      d.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to item ' + (i + 1));
      (function (idx) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { current = idx; render(); }); })(i);
      dotsBox.appendChild(d);
    }
  }

  prevBtn && prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { go(-1); });
  nextBtn && nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { go(1); });

  items.forEach(function (el, i) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var pos = el.getAttribute('data-pos');
      if (pos === 'front') return;
      if (pos === 'near-l' || pos === 'far-l') go(1);
      else if (pos === 'near-r' || pos === 'far-r') go(-1);
    });
  });

  // Keyboard navigation
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!stage.getBoundingClientRect().height) return;
    var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.bottom < 0 || r.top > window.innerHeight) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { go(-1); pulseAuto(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(1); pulseAuto(); }
  });

  // Touch swipe (mobile)
  var touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0, lastSwipeAt = 0;
  stage.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  }, { passive: true });
  stage.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
    if (!e.changedTouches || e.changedTouches.length !== 1) return;
    var t = e.changedTouches[0];
    var dx = t.clientX - touchStartX;
    var dy = t.clientY - touchStartY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 40 || Math.abs(dx) <= Math.abs(dy)) return;
    if (dx < 0) go(-1); else go(1);
    pulseAuto();
    lastSwipeAt = Date.now();
  }, { passive: true });
  // Suppress item-click that fires right after a swipe (touch synthesizes click)
  items.forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (Date.now() - lastSwipeAt < 400) { e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); }
    }, true);
  });

  // Auto-rotate
  var auto = null;
  var paused = false;
  var inView = false;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function tick() { if (!paused && inView) go(1); }
  function startAuto() { if (reduced || auto) return; auto = setInterval(tick, 4500); }
  function stopAuto() { if (auto) { clearInterval(auto); auto = null; } }
  function pulseAuto() { stopAuto(); startAuto(); }
  stage.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { paused = true; });
  stage.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { paused = false; });
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (e) {
        inView = e.isIntersecting;
        if (inView) startAuto(); else stopAuto();

    io.observe(stage);
  } else {
    inView = true; startAuto();
  }
  items.forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', pulseAuto);
  });

})();

// Starry sky canvas
(function () {
  var canvas = document.querySelector('[data-ezcar-stars]');
  if (!canvas) return;
  var host = canvas.parentElement;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  var W = 0, H = 0;
  var stars = [];
  var shooting = [];
  var nextShootAt = 0;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var DRIFT_X = -0.049;
  var DRIFT_Y = 0.0084;
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function build() {
    var rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width));
    H = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height));
    canvas.width = W * DPR;
    canvas.height = H * DPR;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    var area = W * H;
    var count = Math.round(area / 26000);
    count = Math.max(25, Math.min(55, count));
    stars = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var bias = Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.8);
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: bias * H * 0.6,
        r: rand(0.4, 1.6),
        baseOp: rand(0.18, 0.5),
        twAmp: rand(0.08, 0.2),
        twSpeed: rand(0.0006, 0.0018),
        twPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        vx: DRIFT_X + rand(-0.0056, 0.0056),
        vy: DRIFT_Y + rand(-0.0028, 0.0028),
        halo: Math.random() < 0.18
      });
    }
  }
  function spawnShoot() {
    shooting.push({
      x: rand(W * 0.55, W * 0.98),
      y: rand(H * 0.03, H * 0.10),
      dx: -rand(7, 11),
      dy: rand(0.8, 2.0),
      life: 0,
      maxLife: rand(60, 90),
      tailLen: rand(75, 115)
    });
  }
  function drawShoot(s) {
    var prog = s.life / s.maxLife;
    var alpha = Math.max(0, Math.sin(prog * Math.PI));
    var headX = s.x, headY = s.y;
    var motionLen = Math.sqrt(s.dx * s.dx + s.dy * s.dy);
    var ux = s.dx / motionLen, uy = s.dy / motionLen;
    var tailX = headX - ux * s.tailLen;
    var tailY = headY - uy * s.tailLen;
    var grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(tailX, tailY, headX, headY);
    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
    grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (alpha * 0.55) + ')');
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + alpha + ')');
    ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tailX, tailY);
    ctx.lineTo(headX, headY);
    ctx.stroke();
    var gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(headX, headY, 0, headX, headY, 5);
    gg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + alpha + ')');
    gg.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(220, 230, 255, ' + (alpha * 0.6) + ')');
    gg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220, 230, 255, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(headX, headY, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    s.x += s.dx;
    s.y += s.dy;
    s.life++;
  }
  function tick(t) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    for (var i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      var s = stars[i];
      if (!reduced) {
        s.x += s.vx;
        s.y += s.vy;
        if (s.x < -2) s.x = W + 2;
        else if (s.x > W + 2) s.x = -2;
        if (s.y < -2) s.y = H * 0.6 + 2;
        else if (s.y > H * 0.6 + 2) s.y = -2;
      }
      var twinkle = reduced ? 0 : Math.sin(t * s.twSpeed + s.twPhase) * s.twAmp;
      var op = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.baseOp + twinkle));
      if (s.halo) {
        var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, s.r * 6);
        g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190, 210, 255, ' + (op * 0.2) + ')');
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190, 210, 255, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + op + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    if (!reduced) {
      if (t > nextShootAt) {
        spawnShoot();
        nextShootAt = t + rand(18000, 24000);
      }
      for (var j = shooting.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        drawShoot(shooting[j]);
        if (shooting[j].life >= shooting[j].maxLife) shooting.splice(j, 1);
      }
    }
    if (!reduced) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  build();
  nextShootAt = performance.now() + rand(5000, 9000);
  if (reduced) {
    requestAnimationFrame(function (t) { tick(t); });
  } else {
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () { build(); });
    ro.observe(host);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('resize', build);
  }
})();

// Shared gradient: measure carousel + ezhome heights, set CSS vars
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  function update() {
    var car = document.querySelector('.ezh-car');
    var ezhome = document.querySelector('.ezhome');
    if (!car || !ezhome) return;
    var h1 = car.offsetHeight;
    var h2 = ezhome.offsetHeight;
    root.style.setProperty('--ezh-shared-h', (h1 + h2) + 'px');
    root.style.setProperty('--ezh-shared-off', '-' + h1 + 'px');
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', update);
  else update();
  window.addEventListener('load', update);
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    clearTimeout(window.__ezhSharedT);
    window.__ezhSharedT = setTimeout(update, 100);
  });
  if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
    var ro = new ResizeObserver(update);
    var observe = function () {
      var car = document.querySelector('.ezh-car');
      var ezhome = document.querySelector('.ezhome');
      if (car) ro.observe(car);
      if (ezhome) ro.observe(ezhome);
    };
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', observe);
    else observe();
  }
})();

<script>
  (function () {
    var root = document.querySelector('.ezh-rev');
    if (!root) return;

    // ===== Carousel activate =====
    var items = root.querySelectorAll('[data-package]');
    var bundles = root.querySelectorAll('[data-bundle]');
    var doorbells = root.querySelectorAll('.ezh-rev__doorbell');
    if (!items.length || !bundles.length) return;

    // Package 3 (idx 2) reuses Package 2's bundle image — only the doorbell overlay differs
    var bundleMap = { 0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 1 };

    function activate(idx) {
      items.forEach(function (li, i) {
        li.classList.toggle('is-active', i === idx);
      });
      var bundleIdx = bundleMap[idx] != null ? bundleMap[idx] : idx;
      bundles.forEach(function (b, i) {
        if (b.classList.contains('is-active') && i !== bundleIdx) {
          b.classList.remove('is-active');
          b.classList.add('is-leaving');
          b.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          setTimeout(function () { b.classList.remove('is-leaving'); }, 900);
        }
      });
      var next = bundles[bundleIdx];
      if (next && !next.classList.contains('is-active')) {
        next.classList.remove('is-leaving');
        // Trigger reflow so transition runs from initial state (translateY -120, opacity 0)
        void next.offsetWidth;
        next.classList.add('is-active');
        next.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      }

      doorbells.forEach(function (d) {
        if (idx === 2) {
          if (!d.classList.contains('is-active')) {
            d.classList.remove('is-leaving');
            void d.offsetWidth;
            d.classList.add('is-active');
          }
        } else if (d.classList.contains('is-active')) {
          d.classList.remove('is-active');
          d.classList.add('is-leaving');
          setTimeout(function () { d.classList.remove('is-leaving'); }, 900);
        }
      });

      var cards = root.querySelectorAll('.ezh-rev__card');
      cards.forEach(function (c) {
        var cardIdx = parseInt(c.dataset.cardPackage, 10);
        c.classList.remove('is-animating');
        if (cardIdx === idx) {
          // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-expressions
          c.offsetWidth;
          c.classList.add('is-active');
          c.classList.add('is-animating');
        } else {
          c.classList.remove('is-active');
        }
      });

      segBtns.forEach(function (b) {
        var bp = parseInt(b.dataset.segPackage, 10);
        var on = bp === idx;
        b.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
        b.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      });

      scheduleNext();
    }

    var segBtns = root.querySelectorAll('[data-seg-package]');
    segBtns.forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        activate(parseInt(b.dataset.segPackage, 10));
      });
    });

    var AUTOPLAY_MS = 5000;
    var autoplayTimer = null;
    function scheduleNext() {
      clearTimeout(autoplayTimer);
      if (root.classList.contains('is-paused')) return;
      autoplayTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        var current = root.querySelector('[data-package].is-active');
        var curIdx = current ? parseInt(current.dataset.package, 10) : 0;
        var nextIdx = (curIdx + 1) % items.length;
        activate(nextIdx);
      }, AUTOPLAY_MS);
    }

    items.forEach(function (li, i) {
      li.addEventListener('click', function () { activate(i); });
    });

    var listEl = root.querySelector('.ezh-rev__list');
    if (listEl) {
      listEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
        root.classList.add('is-paused');
        clearTimeout(autoplayTimer);
      });
      listEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
        root.classList.remove('is-paused');
        scheduleNext();
      });
    }

    // kick off autoplay on load
    scheduleNext();
  })();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var carousel = document.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__carousel');
  if (!carousel) return;
  var track = carousel.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__track');
  if (!track) return;
  var cards = track.querySelectorAll('.ezhome-popular__card');
  if (cards.length <= 4) return;
  var prevBtn = document.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__nav--prev');
  var nextBtn = document.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__nav--next');
  var peek = carousel.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__peek');
  var index = 0;
  function getStep(){
    var cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).columnGap || getComputedStyle(track).gap || '32') || 32;
    return cardW + gap;
  }
  function getMaxIndex(){
    var viewport = carousel.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__viewport');
    if (!viewport) return cards.length - 1;
    var step = getStep();
    var trackWidth = cards.length * step - (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).columnGap || '32') || 32);
    var visibleWidth = viewport.clientWidth;
    var hiddenWidth = Math.max(0, trackWidth - visibleWidth);
    return Math.ceil(hiddenWidth / step);
  }
  function update(){
    var step = getStep();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-index * step) + 'px)';
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = index <= 0;
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = index >= getMaxIndex();
    if (peek) peek.style.display = index >= getMaxIndex() ? 'none' : '';
  }
  function next(){ var m = getMaxIndex(); if (index < m) { index++; update(); } }
  function prev(){ if (index > 0) { index--; update(); } }
  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prev);
  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
  if (peek) peek.addEventListener('click', next);
  var resizeIv;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    clearTimeout(resizeIv);
    resizeIv = setTimeout(function(){
      var m = getMaxIndex();
      if (index > m) index = m;
      update();
    }, 120);
  });
  update();

  // Touch swipe (mobile)
  var viewport = carousel.querySelector('.ezhome-popular__viewport');
  if (viewport) {
    var touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0;
    viewport.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
      if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
      touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    }, { passive: true });
    viewport.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
      if (!e.changedTouches || e.changedTouches.length !== 1) return;
      var t = e.changedTouches[0];
      var dx = t.clientX - touchStartX;
      var dy = t.clientY - touchStartY;
      if (Math.abs(dx) < 40 || Math.abs(dx) <= Math.abs(dy)) return;
      if (dx < 0) next(); else prev();
    }, { passive: true });
  }
})();
</script>

  <script>
    (function(){
      var sticky=document.getElementById('cart-count-bubble-sticky');
      if(!sticky)return;
      function update(count){
        sticky.textContent=' '+count+' ';
        sticky.style.display=count===0||count==='0'?'none':'';
      }
      function ck(){
        var c=sticky.textContent.trim();
        sticky.style.display=c==='0'||c===''?'none':'';
      }
      ck();
      /* Sync from header cart count */
      var header=document.getElementById('cart-icon-bubble');
      if(header){
        new MutationObserver(function(){
          var spans=header.querySelectorAll('.cart-count-bubble span');
          var val='0';
          spans.forEach(function(s){var t=s.textContent.trim();if(t&&!isNaN(t))val=t;});
          update(parseInt(val)||0);
        }).observe(header,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
      }
      /* Also add badge to mios header cart */
      var miosCart=document.getElementById('mios-th');
      var miosBadge=null;
      if(miosCart){
        miosCart.style.position='relative';
        miosBadge=document.createElement('span');
        miosBadge.className='fk-mios-cart-badge';
        miosBadge.style.cssText='position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;background:#FE5C15;color:#FFF;font-size:11px;min-width:18px;height:18px;line-height:18px;text-align:center;border-radius:50%;display:none;font-family:Ezlo Sans,sans-serif;font-weight:600;';
        miosCart.appendChild(miosBadge);
      }
      function updateAll(count){
        update(count);
        if(miosBadge){
          miosBadge.textContent=count;
          miosBadge.style.display=count>0?'block':'none';
        }
      }
      /* Intercept fetch for cart changes */
      var origFetch=window.fetch;
      window.fetch=function(){
        var args=arguments;
        var url=typeof args[0]==='string'?args[0]:args[0]&&args[0].url||'';
        var result=origFetch.apply(this,args);
        if(url.indexOf('/cart')!==-1){
          result.then(function(){
            setTimeout(function(){
              origFetch('/cart.js').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(data){
                updateAll(data.item_count||0);
              }).catch(function(){});
            },500);
          }).catch(function(){});
        }
        return result;
      };
      /* Initial count check */
      origFetch('/cart.js').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(data){
        updateAll(data.item_count||0);
      }).catch(function(){});
      new MutationObserver(ck).observe(sticky,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});
    })();
  </script>

Worked well on refrigerator with automation to alert if left open. 1.15" detection distance.

I'm using this Zigbee door/window open sensor on the refrigerator to alert when it's left open and it's working great. I have it turn the lights red when refrigerator/freezer is open, and sound an alarm after a while. It has a wider 1.15" detection distance than their other door/window sensor, and I was able to adjust it so even a slight gap in the door wouldn't register as closed. It paired smoothly with Home Assistant using ZHA. Range was good, easily reaching 30 feet through walls to the kitchen. Response to opening/closing was instant. # Agent Instructions — Ezlo - Property Empowered

You can browse products and shop at Ezlo - Property Empowered's online store, https://www.ezlo.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.ezlo.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.ezlo.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.ezlo.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of Service**: https://www.ezlo.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund Policy**: https://www.ezlo.com/policies/refund-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: this document (`/agents.md`) is the canonical agent-facing description of the store.
